title: 'zapier: command not found' in CI after upgrading zapier-platform-cli to 19
symptoms: CI push or validate step fails right after a dependency bump
Docs and scripts still call zapier push
cause: CLI 19.0.0, released 2026-05-18, removed the zapier binary. The command is now zapier-platform, which 18.x already offered alongside the deprecated name.
fix: Replace zapier with zapier-platform in scripts, CI jobs and package.json scripts.
apply: npx zapier-platform validate && npx zapier-platform push
